scope: Nine completed baseline archives only; local CPU analysis, no live runtime access or mutation
schedules_comparison: Reconstructed with original archived function, original protocols and verified image dimensions

code_qualification.shared_source: Frozen model loader, preprocessing, native loss, sampling and LR functions match byte-for-byte where bundled.
code_qualification.wrapper: Colab uses a separate training loop with checkpoint/resume and extra SDF/depth diagnostics.
code_qualification.baseline_objective: Original: native + ramp*(0*bands + 0*edge). Extension: native + ramp*sum(empty weights). Same mathematical objective; different backward graph.
code_qualification.causality: The impact of the zero-weight backward branches has not been tested on this model/GPU. No root-cause attribution is made.
code_qualification.preflight_coverage: Prior strict audit compares shared per-term losses/gradients and optimizer resume, not the original full baseline train_arm loop against the new baseline loop.
code_qualification.calibration: Fresh Colab calibration is intentional for constrained runs; baseline weights are empty, so calibration coefficients do not explain baseline differences.
code_qualification.runtime: Exact historical numerical environment has not been fully reconstructed. Original requested a 3g.40gb MIG allocation; Colab records A100-SXM4-80GB.

preservation: No running job, notebook, package, checkpoint, calibration or result was changed. No GPU experiments launched.
initialization: All nine archived Colab frozen_before/frozen_after and adapter_before hashes match original cluster baseline records; the base checkpoint and medical adapter files match archived local originals.
source_packaging: Two package __init__.py files have been emptied to avoid unrelated imports; the nine included original computation/source files match byte-for-byte.
lr_roundoff: The same original cosine function matches the recorded schedule to at most two float64 ULPs when recomputed on this Mac (maximum absolute delta 6.776263578034403e-21); all float32 values are identical. Exact mismatches retained in findings.json.
sampling: Same training case list across seeds within each fold; each seed changes slab sampling order. Original SAM3 dropout remains active in train mode, while LoRA-specific dropout is zero. No image augmentation.

prior_runtime_diagnostic.interpretation: Runtime-dependent forward difference exists before training; no isolated causal attribution to one kernel or to the wrapper graph change.

limitations: Read saved records and local frozen packages; no live GPU process instrumentation.
Original raw slab schedule and original per-update history were not preserved in the available archive; sampling checked by original function reconstruction.
Whole-loop original-versus-extension GPU equivalence is unverified.
Constrained-arm gains must use new matched Colab baselines; historical cluster results remain a separate reference.
